name: Nandi Nkosi
bio:
Nandi's journey into motorsport was a winding one. Initially trained as an automotive spray painter, she found herself drawn to the vibrant and demanding world of racing liveries. After years of working in commercial vehicle refinishing, she took a leap of faith, volunteering her skills at a local racing team. Her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication quickly earned her a reputation for excellence. 

At Nostalgia Racing, Nandi is known for her unwavering attention to detail. She believes that a flawless paint job is not just about aesthetics, but also about protecting the car's bodywork and optimizing its aerodynamic performance. She is a firm believer in using traditional techniques alongside modern technology, ensuring that every vehicle that leaves her workshop is a true work of art. She is fiercely proud of her work and the team she supports.

physical.hairStyle: Close-cropped afro with subtle grey streaks at the temples
physical.description: Nandi has a sturdy build and a warm, welcoming smile that crinkles the corners of her eyes.

quirks: Always hums traditional Xhosa songs while working.
Insists on using only natural bristle brushes for fine detailing.
Has a small collection of vintage racing decals displayed in her workspace.
